Through its Designated Partner

LEGAL NOTICE UNDER THE CONSUMER PROTECTION ACT, 2019 FOR DEFECTIVE GOODS, DEFICIENCY IN SERVICE AND UNFAIR TRADE PRACTICE

Sir / Madam,

Under instructions from and on behalf of my client, Mr. SRINIVAS RAO KOLLURI, aged 44 years, residing at Flat 704, Lakeview Residency, Madhapur, Hyderabad 500081, Telangana (hereinafter "my client"), I hereby serve upon you the following legal notice.

1. That on 3 August 2026, my client purchased from your showroom a Premium Series "AquaPure RO+UV" 25-litre water purification system with Model No. AP-RO25-2026 and Serial No. APR25-26-04418 (the "Product"), manufactured by Hydra Aquatech India Limited, for a total consideration of Rs 85,000/- (Rupees Eighty-Five Thousand only), paid by credit card, against your Tax Invoice No. AHA/26-27/00977 dated 3 August 2026. The Product carries a warranty of two (2) years from the date of purchase and was sold to my client as a product of "hospital-grade purification, with zero water wastage and a 10-year membrane life", as stated in the brochure and by your salesperson. A copy of the invoice and brochure is enclosed.

2. That my client is a "consumer" within the meaning of Section 2(7) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, having bought the Product for his personal and domestic use for consideration, and you are a "seller" within the meaning of the Act.

3. That the Product was installed at my client's residence by your technician on 6 August 2026. Within two weeks of the installation, the Product started showing serious defects, including continuous leakage from the pre-filter housing, an error code "E4" displayed continuously, and the output water having a salty taste and a TDS reading of 480 ppm against the promised level of less than 50 ppm, as measured by my client with a TDS meter and also at an accredited laboratory, whose report dated 2 September 2026 is enclosed.
4. That my client lodged complaints with you on 22 August 2026 (Complaint No. AHA/SR/2026/3311), 5 September 2026 (Complaint No. AHA/SR/2026/3452) and 25 September 2026 (Complaint No. AHA/SR/2026/3590), and also by emails dated 29 August and 12 September 2026. Your technicians visited on 24 August, 8 September and 28 September 2026, and on each occasion, purported to repair the Product, replaced the pre-filter housing and a solenoid valve, but the defects persisted. On the last visit, your technician himself admitted in writing that the "membrane assembly is defective and needs replacement from the manufacturer, which would take 60 to 90 days". Despite this, you have neither replaced the Product nor refunded the amount.

5. That the Product suffers from manufacturing defects and a "defect" within the meaning of Section 2(10) of the Act, and your failure to rectify the same despite three attempts, and your refusal to replace the Product or refund the price, amount to "deficiency" in service within Section 2(11) and the misleading claims made in the advertisement and brochure constitute a "misleading advertisement" within Section 2(28) and "unfair trade practice" within Section 2(47) of the Act. The Product liability of the seller and manufacturer arises under Chapter VI of the Act, particularly Section 86 and Section 84.

6. That my client and his family, which includes two senior citizens and a child, were forced to purchase packaged drinking water for over two months and have suffered considerable mental agony, harassment and inconvenience on account of your deficiency and unfair trade practices, which my client estimates, conservatively, at Rs 1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only).

7. That I, therefore, on behalf of my client, hereby call upon you, by this notice, to do the following within thirty (30) days of the receipt of this notice, that is, on or before 14 November 2026:

(a) refund to my client the sum of Rs 85,000/- (Rupees Eighty-Five Thousand only), being the price of the Product, together with interest at 9% per annum from 3 August 2026 till the date of payment, against the return of the Product at your cost;
(b) pay to my client a sum of Rs 1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) as compensation for the mental agony, harassment, loss and inconvenience; and
(c) pay a sum of Rs 10,000/- as the cost of this notice and the litigation expenses.

8. That in case you fail to comply with the above demand within the stipulated period of thirty (30) days, my client shall be constrained to file a consumer complaint against you and the manufacturer before the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission at Hyderabad, under Section 35 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, praying for the refund, compensation, punitive damages under Section 39(1)(d), costs and all other reliefs, including an order for discontinuance of the misleading claims and for corrective advertisement. The District Commission has jurisdiction under Section 34 as the consideration paid does not exceed Rs 50 lakh.

9. That the proceedings shall be at your risk as to cost and consequences, and non-compliance with the Commission's order attracts penalty under Section 72 of the Act. My client is willing to settle through mediation if you make a written offer within the above period. A copy of this notice is also being sent to the manufacturer, M/s Hydra Aquatech India Limited, Pune.

Yours faithfully,

(P. Ramakrishnan)
Advocate
Enrolment No. AP/5678/2010

Enclosures: (1) Tax Invoice dated 3 August 2026; (2) Warranty card and brochure; (3) Complaint emails and job-sheets; (4) Laboratory test report dated 2 September 2026; (5) Photographs and video of the leakage.
